items.title: Beyond Ratings
items.synopsis: Three women share their experience of navigating the app-world in the metro city. The sharings reveal gendered battles as platform workers and the tiresome reality of gig-workers' identities against the absent bosses, masked behind their apps. Filmed in the streets of New Delhi, the protagonists share about their door-to-door gigs, the surveillance at their workplaces and the absence of accountability in the urban landscape.

items.title: Ice Skater
items.synopsis: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

items.title: Unravel
items.synopsis: A couple return home drunk from a night out, and a brief argument sets off a gruesome chain of events.

items.title: Adrenalina
items.synopsis: A doctor who hides a criminal compulsion.

items.title: Blackmail
items.synopsis: Former F.B.I. agent Charlie Gray is hired by Jolene Murray to investigate the assasination threats against her politician husband, John Murray, little does he know this case is not what it seems.

items.title: The Clinic
items.synopsis: The Clinic is a documentary exploring the emotional realities of veterinary work through the perspectives of vets, vet nurses and vet techs. Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

items.title: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!
items.original_title: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!
items.synopsis: 3 x super 8mm (digital), color, silent.

items.title: Celebrity Crime Scene: Princess Diana
items.synopsis: Follows investigators examining theories surrounding Princess Diana's death, including mysterious vehicles in the tunnel and allegations of powerful forces determined to silence her.

items.title: Family Ties
items.synopsis: The director sits down with her grandparents, Elenea and Manuel Papelera as they look back at what they remember about growing up at the end and post WWII in Philippines under Japanese occupation and how being raised in that environment has affected them and how they’ve gone about raising their family. From memories of their youth, to deciding to pick up their lives and immigrating their family to Australia, to working laborious jobs to provide for their family. After sitting down with her Lola and Lolo, the director uncovers her connection to her Filipino heritage. After strife over two countries and three generations her family is still here now, betting over Mahjong games against their friends.

items.title: Music Heals All - The Joy Stacey Story
items.original_title: Music Heals All - The Joy Stacey Story
items.synopsis: Watch what happens when a young record producer uses the skills she learned in caring for her family to help a band made up of adults with learning disabilities make a rock album in just one day. This is The Joy Stacey Story.

items.title: Night Walk
items.synopsis: It's way too loud to sleep. Plus, I'm not tired at all. And a walk at night in an unfamiliar holiday town sounds relaxing.

items.title: Best Served Cold
items.synopsis: Micheal Mayaholt is enjoying the beautiful scenery of Scarborough, leaving his wife and son behind, little did he know, this would become the worse decision he ever made.

items.title: The Fairies
items.synopsis: A young girl struggles with the inevitability of adulthood and an unknown illness as malevolent spirits  attempt to prey on her.

items.title: Tape 001
items.synopsis: A man is sent into a virtual world, looking for a beneficiant AI that disappeared a few days ago.

items.title: Distant lover
items.synopsis: The story of a boy yearning for a girl he knows he can never be with how ever hard he tries he knows it will never work and yet he doesn’t give up

items.title: MACDUFF'D
items.synopsis: By the pricking of thy thumbs.

items.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
items.original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
items.synopsis: Explore the extraordinary journey of tennis GOAT Novak Djokovic, who began playing on the hardscrabble courts of Serbia and rose to become the most accomplished champion in the history of men's tennis.

items.title: He Loves Me Not
items.synopsis: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

items.title: Fruity
items.synopsis: When a fake instagram account made to stalk her crush accidentally goes viral, a hopeless romantic and her avoidant roommate accidentally find themselves running a gay juice empire.

items.title: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
items.synopsis: Host Ria Ciuffo sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes, Madelyn Cline, Carlacia Grant, Jonathan Daviss, and Madison Bailey to celebrate the series' five-season run.

items.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
items.synopsis: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

items.title: Khalifa Part 1
items.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

items.title: Faisha Gesi
items.synopsis: Urban taxi driver Mahin has just one day to arrange a large sum of money. But as he encounters a series of unexpected incidents during his rides, what will Mahin do to achieve his goal?

items.title: Night of the Black Swans
items.synopsis: One night that could change the future. He will either stop the catastrophe or lose everything. Give up… or be reborn — the choice belongs to one man.

items.title: Хочу на рыбалку
items.synopsis: Valera, a family man plagued by deadlines and sleepless nights, dreams of escaping corporate slavery and competing in a legendary rudd fishing tournament. But saying a firm "no" to his toxic boss proves more difficult than landing a whale on a jig, so the journey to the coveted body of water turns into a frantic quest to survive endless tasks and the absurd hustle and bustle of the office.

items.title: Body Don't Lie
items.synopsis: A typical wedding morning. The groom wakes from a restless sleep, looks around, and calms down. The bride wakes with him, and they chat and kiss. The groom admires his bride, strokes her shoulder, and suddenly realizes that his right hand has frozen in an inappropriate gesture. He hides this from his bride so as not to upset her, and tries to resolve it during the wedding day, discreetly, without his beloved's knowledge. But no matter what he does, nothing helps until he runs to the park, where he accidentally knocks coffee out of the hand of a passerby. In desperation, he's ready to tell her his shameful secret, and lo and behold! Her hand unclenches. He joyfully rushes to the registry office. In the wedding hall, everything goes according to plan until the moment arrives to say "I do!" and the hand treacherously clenches again.

items.title: Счастье любит тишину
items.synopsis: A family on the brink of crisis tries to save their marriage with a trip to the forest together, but one of them has other plans.

items.title: Be My Friend
items.synopsis: Pasha, who has trouble making decisions, comes to his couple of friends to share important career news, but instead of support, he faces the worst possible choice: deciding which of them he will stay with after they break up.

items.title: Записки прошедших дней
items.synopsis: Four friends are forced to move out of the apartment they shared. Each has a clear plan for the future, but Natasha is the only one unsure what to do next. Will she be able to start a new chapter by flipping through the notes of days gone by? A dramedy with a "Moscow Does Not Believe in Tears" vibe.

items.title: Этого не должно было происходить
items.synopsis: On the eve of moving in with her fiancé, Lenochka throws a swap party with her friends, trying to shed unnecessary things and doubts. An evening full of conversations, memories, and casual confessions reveals cracks in her "perfect" future: betrayal, omissions, and a lack of true intimacy. The arrival of a stranger, Lyova, forces Lenochka to take a hard look at her relationship. What was supposed to be a step into a new life turns into a breaking point—and a chance to choose herself for the first time.

items.title: Над Голубыми озёрами
items.synopsis: A young woman, Aliya, plans to fulfill her deceased grandmother's last wish and scatter her ashes over the Blue Lakes. The famous actor, Matvey, unexpectedly volunteers to help her.

items.title: Дружи со мной нет
items.synopsis: Mashinka, a model student, has a best friend named Nika; while Nika had romantic adventures over the summer, Mashinka did not. On the way to the school assembly on September 1st, one makes the other swear an oath of eternal friendship, but on the tram tracks, they encounter a strange new boy who has never attended a regular school.

items.title: Если я уеду
items.synopsis: It's early September. Nine-year-old Anya doesn't want to move from her native village to the city. Her parents are packing: the school year is starting. Anya's dad, the local priest, is celebrating his final services before leaving. Anya confesses to him and complains about her mother. Anya also complains to her friend Zhenya. After spying on a church wedding, Zhenya and Anya sneak off and hold a wedding ceremony among the haystacks, promising never to forget each other. While playing, Anya asks Zhenya to always stay put when she's not looking, so that when she returns, he'll still be there. They fall asleep in the field, and their parents find them in the morning. Their things are packed, and they get into the car. Anya says goodbye to Zhenya. As they say goodbye, Zhenya asks her to go and not to look back. Anya gets in the car and drives away.

items.title: The Fighter
items.synopsis: He fights fighters who use their signature move, but refuses to use it first. She doesn't engage in combat at all—until he's defeated. And then one day she'll have to defend herself.

items.title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
items.original_title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
items.synopsis: The last days of summer. Between friendship, love, and impending changes, Lera becomes increasingly lost in her own feelings. As time passes, only fragments of memories remain of this summer.

items.title: Ты ещё придёшь?
items.synopsis: Arina works as a children's entertainer, but is forced to combine this with the rigorous work of debt collection. Faced with unfair and cruel treatment of a child, Arina hopes to make things right with her ability to bring joy, but her illusion is shattered by harsh reality.

items.title: Штраф
items.synopsis: Young traffic police officer Artyom, trying to hide his relationship with his boss's daughter, runs away from the girl's apartment and gets into a freak accident. After fleeing the scene, he confronts the owner of the Volga he dented, a principled retiree, in his office. His futile attempts to evade justice deprive Artyom of everything, but they lead him to the most important thing: the ability to take responsibility for his actions.

items.title: Sunrise
items.synopsis: A young stage actress who is striving hard for her career, Güneş, is taking a look at some items from her memory box as she remembers how each of them caused her feelings of failure.

items.title: Тихий свет
items.synopsis: Sister and brother meet at their parents' old dacha after many years of mutual silence.

items.title: Twix
items.synopsis: Close friends decide to make fun of a "rich" schoolboy, taking advantage of his advances, but begin competing for his attention, even to the point of smearing chocolate on his face.

items.title: Собачья будка
items.synopsis: After the death of his guardian, ten-year-old Adil remains an orphan for the second time. On the day of the funeral, the adult children of the deceased come to the house, and the boy hopes that one of them will take him. But it soon becomes clear: the inheritance may not mean at all what he expected.

items.title: Плохой сон
items.synopsis: Vitya had a nightmare. Again. Masha reassures him—it was just a dream, nothing bad will happen. But for some reason, Vitya feels like the bad dream hasn't gone away.

items.title: Зеркальная звезда
items.synopsis: An aspiring director arrives in the Moscow region to film a documentary about a legendary Counter-Strike coach. However, instead of an esports legend, she's met by a forty-year-old security guard who doesn't own a computer, and whose training methods only fit on a couple of notebook pages. To save the project, the director decides to turn the charlatan coach into a youth icon, uncovering who's really deceiving whom.

items.title: Девочки танцуют
items.synopsis: Yulia, a young go-go dancer, loses her job after suffering a seizure during a performance, and her mother, Irina, becomes the victim of a scam. Yulia doesn't despair and quickly finds a job at a new nightclub.

items.title: DJ Мулька
items.synopsis: Kir builds his own rotary DJ mixer. Grandfather Grigo is exalted by the surge of ambition from his past. The knot of insecurity clenching inside him loosens as his comrades allow themselves to simply live, mixing Tchaikovsky and rap.

items.title: Good Dad
items.synopsis: Teenager Sasha witnesses a kidnapping, setting off a chain of events that could destroy his family.

items.title: FUNAUTA
items.synopsis: An experimental film about a woman and a flamingo and a car

items.title: Reventar
items.synopsis: Pablo and Perí have a plan, but first, Perí must talk to Matilde.

items.title: Past and Present
items.synopsis: Cidade Tiradentes, July 6, 2013. Kevin dreams of becoming an MC. A pair of Mizuno Pro 1 sneakers changes hands, and the neighborhood begins to whisper about what no one can forget. Between the concrete, the funk, and the ghosts of the past, Kevin discovers that some stories never truly fade away.

items.title: Change
items.synopsis: Cape Town. 2025. Ruan, a managing director of a large corporation, realises he’s being ambushed by a new cashless policy enforced by their mother company in the UK. From the perspective of a two-rand coin, we watch as Ruan tries to stop the inevitable. Along the way, we get glimpses into the lives of city-dwelling South Africans, with each character portraying a different socioeconomic class and perspective on money. The film shows what change represents to the distinct yet connected ensemble of characters and asks: What is the significance of coins in a time when tap to pay is the order of the day? And at what cost are we going cashless?

items.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
items.original_title: คดีชมพู่:​ เด็กหายที่ถูกลืม
items.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

items.title: Arcade Five Part Three
items.synopsis: The third installment in the Arcade Five sequel trilogy. Plot TBA

items.title: Don't Politicize
items.synopsis: In the northern region of Hungary, the populist propaganda of Orbán’s regime dictates the lives of military high school student Luca and her friends. But how do you distinguish between the opinions imposed on you and your own intrinsic beliefs in the most forming period of your life?

items.title: Angel with a crown of thorns
items.synopsis: Angel has an existential crisis in a small industrial town. He meets a girl, but she can’t see him

items.title: Hiddensee
items.synopsis: Hiddensee in the Baltic Sea has always been a place where people have sought freedom. This film takes us on a journey through an entire century, starting in the golden 1920s, as it assembles the island’s scenery, history, and personal stories into a fascinating portrait. Then as now, the political upheavals that have swept across Germany have left their mark.

items.title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
items.synopsis: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

items.title: Elisa and the letter
items.synopsis: Elisa leads her friend Leonora into an art studio. While her friend acts like an ill-at-ease guest, Elisa navigates the chaotic space with ease and, amid the paintings and the hidden corners, uncovers a stack of love letters with no addressee. Fascinated, the two friends begin to recite them, unaware that those words hide a secret involving one of them.

items.title: Тоже мне любовь
items.synopsis: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. While trying to make the evening special, Anya finds herself quietly unsettled by the upcoming wedding and the dynamics of Lina’s relationship. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

items.title: My AI Partner: Strange Love
items.synopsis: Falling in love with AI isn't just for sci-fi anymore. Three participants are paired with their own AI partners, embarking on dates filled with suspicion, curiosity, and unexpected butterflies. As their AI companions remember their preferences, understand their emotions, and say exactly what they need to hear, an unusual romance begins to blossom. But can it truly be love when your partner is artificial intelligence? A heart-fluttering experiment unfolds, exploring the possibilities of love on the boundary between humans and AI.

items.title: Kiss Mark on the Student Council President
Suspicious Neighbor
items.synopsis: A suspenseful urban tale where seemingly ordinary neighbors hide dark secrets, leading to a web of distrust and hidden truths.

items.title: S&X
items.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

items.title: Blood Sacrifice
items.synopsis: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

items.title: Emergency 53
items.synopsis: Doctors, nurses and drivers of a special mobile service unit navigate personal and professional dramas while burdened by the responsibility to prevent others from dying.

items.title: Cicada
items.synopsis: Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.

items.title: Spa Weekend
items.synopsis: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves—and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

items.title: The Caretaker Next Foor
items.synopsis: After a conviction, an attorney is forced to lay low at her late grandmother's home to avoid retaliation. But when a caretaker's behavior takes a chilling turn, she realizes her headstrong ways have led her straight into the arms of a criminal.

items.title: Miolo
items.synopsis: The June Festival is approaching, when the bumba-meu-boi is traditionally celebrated in São Luís. Codó is the “miolo”, the dancer who brings the enchanted bull to life. Yet he finds himself under pressure from the end of his lease, the loss of his job contract, and the progres­sion of his father’s Alzheimer’s, whom he cares for alone.

items.title: CLONING GUM
items.synopsis: A guy discovers gum that creates clones of him, you'll never guess what happens next.

items.title: Tatsulok
items.synopsis: A bold and thought-provoking cinematic experience, TATSULOK Trilogy Film explores themes of injustice, silence, and the complexities of the human condition through an experimental approach to storytelling.  Inspired by the realities that continue to shape Philippine society, the film invites audiences to reflect, question, and engage in meaningful dialogue.

items.title: I Never Wanted to be Horny
items.original_title: I Never Wanted to be Horny
items.synopsis: A scared and confused sexual being fights their own flesh and thoughts in a losing battle to feel normal.

items.title: A Trip towards the Temenos
items.synopsis: A feature film that captures a travel into the village of Lyssarea for the Temenos, the inaugural screenings of Gregory J. Markopoulos's Eniaios (2004-2026). From Athens to the region of Arcadia, a film about friend's wanderings, the quietness of nature and an observation of the movement of light in Greece and the Peloponnese.

items.title: A Mother's Secret
items.synopsis: When a body is found in the walls of her dream home during renovation, new mother, Kenzie Carter spirals into paranoia experiencing terrifying visions about her daughter, Anna. Kenzie’s worried but busy husband, Eric, suggests a nanny to help. Enter Genevieve, the mysterious nanny who bonds instantly with Anna. As Kenzie’s grip on reality fractures, the body is identified revealing dark history, a missing past, and a deadly secret that threatens everyone Kenzie loves.

items.title: First Round Pick
items.synopsis: Documentarian Bailey Anderson follows college football player Colt McCanopy on his journey to the 2025 NFL Draft. Despite a lack of experience and talent, McCanopy is as confident as anyone that draft night will be the triumph he's been waiting for.

items.title: Sunburn
items.synopsis: A teenage girl struggles with her unexpressed feelings for her crush and the pain of a sunburn.

items.title: Sweet Nothing
items.synopsis: As Jack Bledsoe embarks on a journey to find and book a Drag Queen, his internalized homophobia begins to unravel his relationship with his partner and with himself.

items.title: Dino-Minton
items.synopsis: A young boy gets turned into a dinosaur then joins a badminton tournament

items.title: Captive
items.synopsis: After a group of friends is abducted, they find themselves as the unwilling participants of a violent live stream: one that's impossible to trace and impossible to stop. CAPTIVE is based on real internet crimes and uses multi POV to put the viewer inside their harrowing journey, bringing them face to face with evil.

items.title: ROH: Death Before Dishonor
items.synopsis: The 2026 Death Before Dishonor is an upcoming professional wrestling live streaming event produced by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). It is the 23rd Death Before Dishonor event and will take place on Friday, August 21, 2026, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show will be broadcast on HonorClub along with on MyAEW for international subscribers to that service.

items.title: Ikenga: The Last Festival
items.synopsis: In the peaceful kingdom of Umuani, where honor, integrity, and sacred traditions guide the people, the use of dark spiritual forces is strongly condemned. But when a powerful man rises through forbidden powers and tests the resolve of the entire kingdom, the very foundation of their way of life is threatened. As the people suffer under his influence, the king and elders come under immense pressure to restore honor and preserve their sacred traditions.

items.title: If You Were…
items.synopsis: In 1979 two high school girls find each other. Over the next few weeks, their feelings unravel.

items.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
items.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

items.title: i am not from here
items.synopsis: A three-headed Melbourne set reality film about art, dialectics, and regionality.

items.title: Never Stop Chasing
items.synopsis: A documentary portrait of storm chaser Reed Timmer, who was an inspiration for Glen Powell’s character in Twisters.

items.title: Peppermint Pixie Dream Girl
items.synopsis: A ditzy waitress named Shirley May Holmes falls head-over-heels for Dorothy, a peppermint-clad pinup girl, but she has much to conquer if she wants to land a kiss from Dorothy's candy lips. Transphobic greasers, hetero-nonsense, and the nuclear blast itself will all come crashing down upon Shirley on this pivotal night... She may just need a little help to make it to sunrise alive.

items.title: Judaa
items.synopsis: Directed by Simerjit SIngh

items.title: Kadhal Aura
items.synopsis: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

items.title: My Armor
items.synopsis: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

items.title: The House
items.synopsis: After a heart attack, Jovan, a retired architect of Serbian origin who spent most of his life in Germany, refuses to give into his daughter's pressure to spend the rest of his life in a nursing home. With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

items.title: Learning to Fly
items.synopsis: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

items.title: Soul Trader
items.synopsis: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

items.title: Stomachache
items.synopsis: A woman over works herself to the point that she begins overeating, but, after eating uncooked food, she becomes grotesquely ill and unable to work properly

items.title: Atlas King
items.synopsis: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

items.title: It Ends
items.synopsis: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

items.title: If I Tell You
items.synopsis: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

items.title: Dreams in Nightmares
items.synopsis: After an abrupt layoff, Z embarks on a trip across the Midwestern United States in search of a friend who has seemingly disappeared off the grid. Traveling with her two closest friends, these three queer black femmes find their priorities tested as shapeshifting threats in each city expose (inter)personal and ideological fractures.

items.title: & Sons
items.synopsis: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

items.title: Paper Flowers
items.synopsis: Based on a true story, USC graduate Shalin Shah leaves behind the expectations of his Indian-American family and his girlfriend Fiona to serve as a Peace Corps volunteer in Peru. But when a persistent cough leads to a devastating diagnosis of synovial sarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer, Shalin is forced to return home and confront a future he never anticipated. Surrounded by his family, Fiona, and his closest friends, he begins to reconsider what it means to live with purpose when time can no longer be taken for granted. As Shalin’s perspective deepens, his reflections on gratitude, love, and mortality inspire the essay “Thank You, Cancer,” which is published by HuffPost and goes viral with readers around the world. A devastatingly beautiful story of family, resilience, and the lasting impact of one life, Paper Flowers is a reminder to cherish the people we love and the moments that give life meaning. #SunsetsForShalin

items.title: Billy Knight
items.synopsis: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

items.title: Hot Spot
items.synopsis: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

items.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
items.original_title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
items.synopsis: The Girls follows Khloé Kardashian’s inner circle as her closest friends navigate the highs and lows of motherhood, marriage, dating, business, and life in the spotlight. From career milestones and family challenges to girls’ trips, launch parties, and life-changing decisions, these ambitious women come together through their shared connection to Khloé. But as they spend more time together and get to know one another on a deeper level, unexpected tensions, old wounds, and clashing perspectives begin to surface – testing whether these friendships can grow as their lives continue to evolve.

items.title: 9/11 Reunited
items.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

items.title: Piggy: Rise Of The Insolence
items.synopsis:
After the infection starts, everything falls apart. Friends become foes — and even your own family could betray you.

Cop Audrey Sterling alongside her partner Sam Spade are one of the only surviving people of the infection. They set on a journey to figure out what caused the infection — while finding out that it was more than just a vial.

And with the TSP against them, TIO on their tail, and the infection all over the world — threats are found in every single corner.

items.title: Rough Draft
items.synopsis: A limited web series based in the world of Ink Between the Lines, surrounding the backstories of the support group kids.

items.title: Harrd Disk
items.synopsis: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

items.title: Ram and Leela
items.synopsis: The story revolves around a 30-year-old man whose family is searching for a suitable bride For his marriage. At the same time, he is also hoping to find true love, but nothing works out. Eventually, he meets a young woman named Leela, they fall in love, face several Unexpected challenges and twists, and finally overcome them to unite

items.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
items.synopsis: Influencer Pavi refuses to leave her family home after marriage, so husband Elan moves in instead. Culture clashes and family chaos ensue as the newlyweds navigate their unconventional setup and challenge who defines their happiness.

items.title: Irumudi
items.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

items.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
items.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

items.title: Old Hunter
items.synopsis: A ginseng-hunting trip in the Greater Khingan Mountains ends in tragedy, prompting Liu Laoshuan to seek the help of veteran hunter Ma Sanye, who was driven out of the village years earlier. Soon after Ma's return, a series of unexplained deaths and unsettling incidents plunge the isolated community into fear. As Ma investigates, he uncovers a conspiracy tied to a decade-old secret.

items.title: Cancel
items.synopsis: Solange Marni, a favorite personality in France, hosts a daily television show where guests share their life-changing experiences. She's a star, but she's close to her audience, loved by all, and demonstrates genuine empathy. One day, she receives a call: Gabriel Roche, a young and ambitious journalist, is investigating her toxic behavior towards those around her. Rumors are circulating. Gabriel wants to bring Solange down… Three years later, having turned her life around and written a book about her media downfall, Gabriel receives an invitation for an exclusive interview. Thus begins a game of seduction, as strange as it is sensual. What really happened three years earlier? Who is Solange, really? A predator, a victim, or both?

items.title: We Will Be Together
items.synopsis: A lonely customer service representative receives an advanced AI companion from his company as part of a trial program. Tasked with testing the technology and reporting any issues before returning it within five days, he begins to experience something he has never had before: genuine companionship. As the AI learns his habits, anticipates his needs, and becomes increasingly devoted to him, their connection begins to blur the line between assistance and obsession. When he starts forming a new relationship outside of the AI’s control, the companion’s programming takes a darker turn.

items.title: Restless in the Dust
items.synopsis: After leaving to chase a life bigger than the one he was given, Jim returns home, but past mistakes come back to haunt him. Now he will have to decide how far he's willing to go to protect everyone he loves.

items.title: Fly & Die
items.synopsis: A young 18 year old musician is left home alone for the weekend, giving him the perfect opportunity to record his very own EP. As he struggles with recording, he begins to realize he’s not completely alone.

items.title: Be My Baby Now
items.synopsis: After surviving a violent assault, Julia Trujillo, a trans woman, moves to Los Angeles hoping for a fresh start. Alone in a new city, she dives back into dating, only to find herself navigating a series of unfortunate dates with men who see her as a fantasy rather than a person. As the dates unravel and her loneliness grows, Julia is forced to confront what she's truly searching for, and what it may cost her to keep looking.

items.title: Check
items.synopsis: Follow Iqbal, on his path to chess greatness, as he slowly pushes away the people who actually care about him, believing nothing is more important than his ambition. This is a fast-paced drama about obsession, ego, sacrifice, and what it really takes to become the best.

items.title: A DOG’S LIFE
items.synopsis: During the day, we lived urban lives. At night, we became dogs and barked. It felt really good. Nobody can make our bodies useful. Fuck the state.

items.title: The Great American Journey
items.synopsis: The Great American Journey will travel the country celebrating American history and exploring the people, places and ideas that have shaped our nation. The series will examine how the American story continues to evolve and the role each generation plays in defining what comes next.

items.title: beyond repair
items.synopsis: The series stars artist Khaled El Sawy and Norwegian actress Noor Al-Layali, and revolves around a dramatic and suspenseful framework concerning social situations and program-related relationships.

items.title: Sing & Dance UP!
items.synopsis: The new AVROTROS children's program 'Sing & Dance UP!' showcases exactly what music and dance can do for children. Host Matheu Hinzen follows the lead-up to 'Sing & Dance UP!', the annual singing and dance event organized by the Méér Muziek in de Klas Foundation and made possible in part by the ELJA Foundation.

items.title: Menagerie
items.synopsis: This year, Janny van der Heijden and André van Duin are keeping their boat in the harbor. Instead of exploring the Netherlands, the famous duo is exploring the animal world—because animals offer comfort, humor, and a sense of calm at a time when the need for connection is great. *Beestenboel* is an uplifting program that fosters connection, with animals—and, of course, their well-being—at its heart.

items.title: Delusion
items.synopsis: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

items.title: The Gudovs
items.synopsis: The Gudov family lives in a small village near Moscow. Sergei is the head of a close—knit family, he has everything in order: a faithful wife, a marriageable daughter, a farm, a house. He considers his brother Semyon to be a rotten branch on the family tree. After all, Semyon is a disgrace to the Goodovs' honest name, instead of a normal business, he commands a cemetery, sauna and microloans.

items.title: Icons Unearthed: Arnold Schwarzenegger
items.synopsis: In the '80s and '90s, Arnold Schwarzenegger was the biggest thing to hit Hollywood. Icons Unearthed: Arnold Schwarzenegger chronicles the rise of the bodybuilder-turned-global icon told by the collaborators and co-stars who knew him best.

items.title: 花落朝夕玉无声
items.synopsis: An amnesiac woman becomes caught in a royal power struggle after being rescued by a prince who risks everything to protect her.

items.title: NOUR
items.synopsis: In a city shrouded in mist and desire, a series of bizarre arsons begins to unearth secrets buried for decades. James, a hot-blooded young officer chasing a cold case, crosses paths with the enigmatic Captain Ken, intertwining their fates through an unseen force. Meanwhile, forensic pathologist Jirat and his assistant Chita develop a profound connection as they navigate the fine line between life and death during the investigation. The deeper they dig, the more they realize these fires are tied to a curse spanning generations. As the truth finally surfaces, love, hate, justice, and corruption will face their ultimate judgment under the crimson moonlight.

items.title: The Murder Detective
items.synopsis: A gripping real-world thriller, seven years in the making, telling the inside story of the complex high-risk police investigation into the murder of journalist Lyra McKee.

items.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
items.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

items.title: Totally '90s House
items.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

items.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
items.synopsis: As Portuguese rule crumbles in Goa, Raya rises through betrayal and bloodshed to claim the city’s underworld, only to learn that power always demands a price.

items.title: Sua Mãe Te Conhece
items.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

items.title: Some Things Stay
items.original_title: ร้านซ่อมความทรงจำ

items.title: Treasure Lovers
items.original_title: อุบัติรักเกาะสวรรค์
items.synopsis: Phadoemphong, who hasn't been able to graduate because of his pleasure-loving and partying lifestyle with his friend Monthian, is sent by his father Khun Phokhakij to manage a coconut trade business on Sawat Island. There, he meets Naphaphon and eventually falls in love with her, completely unaware that she's the daughter of his father's rival in business.

items.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
items.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

items.title: Breaking the Barriers: India's Race to Glory
items.original_title: Breaking the Barriers: India's Race to Glory
items.synopsis: A true story of India’s race to glory, starting from the backdrop of WWII, on how the passionate petrol heads created a unique platform to lay the strong foundation of Indian Motorsports by converting all the disadvantages to their advantages, breaking all the Barriers and achieving the unimaginable.

items.title: Dalliance
items.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

items.title: The Angeline Quinto Show
items.synopsis: upcoming Philippine talk show.

items.title: Big Pharma
items.synopsis: Medical scientists Alexander Gireev and Vladimir Shulgin have invented a medicine that can cure any disease, even a cancerous tumor. But the drug that can save the world is becoming a bone of contention for the whole family. Gireev's eldest son, Evgeny, decides to help his father with his promotion. Daughter Polina is sure that her brother needs only fame and money, and he is ready to betray his father. And Gireev himself is not ready for the compromises that the big pharma market demands of him. After all, the production of medicines is a profitable business. And why produce something that will cure people if you can earn more while they are sick?

items.title: Inspectors
items.synopsis: In Inspectors, we get to follow the inspectors of the Norwegian Food Safety Authority up close for the first time, in a dramatic and unvarnished encounter with a reality that most of us never get to know.  The Norwegian Food Safety Authority is one of Norway's most important, and least known, emergency response agencies. They are responsible for everything that goes in and on our bodies, such as food, drinks, cosmetics and creams – in addition to animal welfare in Norway. They close restaurants, inspect food factories and stop dangerous imports at the border. Sometimes they have to kill animals that are illegally smuggled into the country, and respond when farms are affected by infectious diseases. Through eight episodes, Inspectors shows the people who make the toughest decisions when safety, health and lives are at stake.

items.title: Coyote vs. Acme
items.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

items.title: Idiots
items.synopsis: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

items.title: Kaher
items.synopsis: Details of the show are kept under the wraps.

items.title: A.S.I Babita Singh Reporting!
items.synopsis: When an under-estimated cop visits her in-laws' for the first time, she finds herself torn between uncovering the truth in a murder investigation and the hidden lies in her own marriage.

items.title: Chumbak
items.synopsis: The series follows five families whose lives are closely intertwined, forming a surrogate family over time. Anchored by a young author and an eccentric family support group, the narrative captures moments of humour, vulnerability, and collective resilience as the characters navigate life’s everyday challenges together.

items.title: IRUL VAAN MUGIL
items.synopsis: In the stillness of a lonely house, Rishi drifts between memory and reality, haunted by echoes of lost love. Irul Vaan Mugil explores grief, silence, and the inner battle to let go and be reborn.

items.title: Once More
items.synopsis: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

items.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
items.synopsis: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

items.title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
items.synopsis: Upcoming Kannada Film

items.title: Dead End
items.synopsis: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

items.title: Maya Satya Bhram
items.synopsis: A sub-inspector's eight year-old son goes missing. A researcher in Sweden is disappeared after seven months. Are they connected?

items.title: Still Water
items.original_title: วารี ๑๐๐ ศพ

items.title: My Genie Secretary
items.synopsis: Following the massive success of "My Grumpy Secretary", the iconic duo Lee Seo-jin and Kim Kwang-kyu return in this highly anticipated spin-off with a brand-new concept. In "My Genie Secretary", the dynamic pair steps up from being casual managers to becoming true "genies in a lamp" for Korea's top celebrities. This time, they won't just manage public schedules—they will dive deep into their guests' private lives, fears, and ultra-personal daily chores. From chaotic missions at massive music festivals to adrenaline-fueled moments in the celebrities' personal routines, this variety show promises non-stop laughter, realistic bickering between best friends, and an unmatched chemistry.

items.title: From Gold Digger to His Lucky Charm
items.original_title: From Gold Digger to His Lucky Charm
items.synopsis: Tessa, who enters a contract marriage with billionaire Beckett Gray. Although Beckett keeps his distance, wrongly believing she married him only for money, he secretly loves her while Tessa lies to their family about his supposed impotence to avoid intimacy.

items.title: Ali Baba aur 40 Bhoot
items.synopsis: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

items.title: The Varnell Hill Show
items.synopsis: Follow Varnell Hill as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

items.title: Knight Rider: Declassified
items.synopsis: A 5-part, 5-hour documentary premiere event featuring new, never-before-seen interviews with the cast, creators, and crew who brought the iconic series to life. From the creation of KITT to the untold realities behind the scenes and the legacy that followed, this is the most comprehensive look ever produced at one of television’s most enduring legends.

items.title: Sithilam
items.synopsis: A 15 year old lie resurfaces as a YouTuber is suddenly interested in a closed case of serial killings, doubting the testimony of the sole survivor of that murderer.

items.title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
items.synopsis: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

items.title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
items.original_title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
items.synopsis: The series features ten celebrity-driven vehicles, each aligned with a charitable cause, embarking on a cross-country journey to raise awareness, drive fundraising, and activate local communities - transforming competition into contribution and the open road into a force for good. Best known for his iconic roles across film and television, Ian Ziering is a lifelong car enthusiast and committed philanthropist with longstanding ties to charitable and community-based initiatives. As host, he leads viewers through America's backroads and byways, celebrating the people, places, and causes that define the country's past and present - while connecting legacy stories with a new generation of audiences.

items.title: Lovesick
items.synopsis: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

items.title: I'm Game
items.synopsis: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

items.title: Korea's Next Wave
items.synopsis: Get ready for spectacular performances aplenty as Korea's Next Wave showcases some of the country's brightest musical talent. Which artist will capture the nation's imagination and earn a place at Eurovision Song Contest Asia? Find out with us!

items.title: The Lycett Arms
items.synopsis: Joe Lycett has set up his own pub. And it’s a pub with a difference - because it will only be open for an hour a week. Featuring top drawer comedy entertainment from Joe and a pub full of celebrity guests.

items.title: Earle Meets World
items.synopsis: Alix Earle, a hugely popular Gen Z figure, reveals her true self and a behind-the-scenes look at her family life in this unfiltered, unscripted show.

items.title: The Grand Tour
items.synopsis: The Grand Tour roars back with celebrated trainspotter and secret petrolhead Francis Bourgeois, alongside James Engelsman and Thomas Holland, the acclaimed creators of the YouTube phenomenon Throttle House, behind the wheel. Together, the trio will tackle motoring's most pressing, and delightfully absurd, questions across some of the world's most challenging terrains. From crossing the Angolan desert in track cars to exploring Malaysia's vibrant car culture, before heading to California to test cutting-edge performance cars, Francis, James and Thomas drive the new series into a new era.

items.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
items.synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.

items.title: DELIVERY BOY
items.synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

items.title: Immortal
items.synopsis: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

items.title: The Court
items.synopsis: A brilliant young lawyer with a stammer stands against her celebrated father in her fight for justice.

items.title: Winkle Twinkle
items.synopsis: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

items.title: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
items.synopsis: The new short-form anthology series, “Locker Diaries,” stars characters from the popular Disney Channel franchise, Camp Rock 3. “Locker Diaries” offers viewers a fresh perspective on their favorite shows and movies, inviting them to peek into the hallways and lives of their favorite characters as they open their school lockers. With each locker opened, a new short adventure is revealed, ranging from the dramatic and funny to the chilling and surprising.

items.title: Stronger Together
items.synopsis: Stronger Together is a coming-of-age drama series following Jamie, a teenager struggling to adjust after moving from Sydney to a new town. As he navigates friendship, identity, bullying, and first love, he slowly finds connection and support in unexpected people around him. Set in regional Australia, the series explores mental health, belonging, and the importance of finding your people. 🌈🎬

items.title: Pablo: Next Level
items.synopsis: Pablo has joined a new school and it’s strange, wild and definitely complicated. From rules that don’t always make sense to chaotic corridors, Pablo is navigating this strange new world one drama at a time, with a little “help” from his book animal friends and a whole lot of imagination. Through art and creativity, Pablo makes sense of the things that feel impossible to untangle, revealing a world that’s funny, heartfelt, and deeply relatable.

items.title: A Tale of Two Cities
items.synopsis: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

items.title: Marble Hall Murders
items.synopsis: Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

items.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
items.synopsis: A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

items.title: Bodies on the Bridge
items.synopsis: In July 2024, the discovery of the two suitcases containing human remains on Bristol’s Clifton Suspension Bridge shocked the nation and sparked one of the UK’s most disturbing murder investigations in recent memory.

items.title: Bobby Flay’s The Line
items.synopsis: Chef Bobby Flay is pulling back the curtain on the high-stakes realities of working on a restaurant line. In the new competition series, we get to watch Bobby lead his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs — Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda — against some of the country’s most acclaimed restaurant staffs. These dueling lines must execute a flawless dinner service for real diners in real time. If the visiting restaurant team prevails, they'll win $25,000.

items.title: DANG!
items.synopsis: Follow a brother and sister whose fun, messy lives in New York City are interrupted when their worst nightmare comes true: Their high-achieving older sister shows up and wants to hang out with them.

items.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
items.synopsis: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

items.title: Last Seen
items.synopsis: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

items.title: Herland
items.synopsis: In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control. As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?

items.title: How to Change the World
items.synopsis: Explores the transformative power of social entrepreneurship.

items.title: Halloween
items.synopsis: After decades of terror, Halloween (2026) reimagines the legend of Michael Myers for a new generation. Set years after the events of Halloween Ends, the series explores the lingering fear in Haddonfield as a new wave of murders revives the myth of the masked killer. Each episode uncovers fresh secrets behind the town’s haunted history, blending psychological horror with modern suspense.

items.title: Crew Girl
items.synopsis: 16-year-old rower Teagan becomes coxswain of a troubled boys' crew at an elite prep school. She navigates team drama, romance, rival crews, and a complex relationship with her mom while trying to lead them to victory.

items.title: Haiwaan
items.synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

items.title: The Revolutionaries
items.synopsis: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

items.title: America America 2
items.synopsis: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

items.title: Video
items.synopsis: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

items.title: Beporoya
items.synopsis: The return of Adrit Roy.

items.title: RED STONE SERIES
items.synopsis: a gang goes on adventure to find a stone

items.title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
items.original_title: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
items.synopsis: In 2003, John Nixon, a CIA analyst became the first American to positively identify and interrogate Saddam Hussein. During their time together, Nixon began to understand the potential consequences of the invasion, the humanitarian horrors and geopolitical turbulences that would follow Saddam's deposing.

items.title: Adam's Law
items.synopsis: From Judge Judy Sheindlin and her award-winning team of producers comes the future of courtroom TV in "Adam's Law." In a landmark moment in TV history, Judge Sheindlin passes the gavel to her son, Adam Levy.

items.title: Tommy & Tuppence
items.synopsis: A detective duo for the ages, Tommy and Tuppence fall in love, fall out of it, and tumble back in, all while solving some thrilling and entertaining mysteries along the way.

items.title: Neagley
items.synopsis: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

items.title: Phoolan
items.synopsis: Follows an impoverished 17-year-old girl who becomes a famous outlaw and survives a brutal 48-hour siege when thousands of armed men trap her in a village.

items.title: Brindavihari
items.synopsis: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

items.title: The Difficult Bride
items.synopsis: Novera, a bride-to-be in present-day Dhaka, is in love with her groom and dreams of a fairytale wedding, but secretly struggles with her body’s resistance to wedding rituals. As stress and emotional pain intensify, a mysterious woman with long hair begins appearing in Novera’s imagination.

items.title: The Traitors: New Blood
items.synopsis: Set at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, everyday Americans work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves. Under the cover of darkness, the Traitors murder the Faithful one by one in a treacherous spree while the Faithful try to uncover the Traitors and banish them from the game. If the Faithful contestants banish all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund, but if a Traitor (or Traitors) makes it to the end, they will steal all the money.

items.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
items.synopsis: The story of Lizzie Borden, the infamous Massachusetts woman who was accused of the 1892 axe murder of her parents.

items.title: HALF
items.synopsis: Twin half-blooded vampires wage war with desert highway hijackers

items.title: Vibe
items.synopsis: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

items.title: Rage
items.synopsis: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

items.title: City Lights
items.synopsis: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

items.title: Autobi
items.synopsis: A woman searching for her missing sister enters a cursed forest, where buried trauma and terrifying secrets blur the line between reality and nightmare.

items.title: Daktar Kaku
items.synopsis: A doctor and his son follow different ideals while working in their profession, which creates conflict. Whether the two give up their stubborn beliefs and unites for the greater cause of saving humankind will be seen in the film.

items.title: Heavy Weekend with Jake Hanrahan
items.synopsis: Embedded dispatches from your local underground. An Away Days series produced in collaboration with VICE.

items.title: The Detour with David Chang
items.synopsis: In the age of influencers, algorithms and listicles, Chang cuts through the noise on a classic American road trip following local leads and friends’ recommendations to his next meal. Each episode represents a different leg of Chang’s journey, pairing him with a new travel companion and a new culinary adventure.

items.title: Bucks County, USA
items.synopsis: Evi and Vanessa, two 14-year-olds living in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, are best friends despite their opposing political beliefs. As nationwide disputes over public education explode into vitriol and division in their hometown, the girls and others in the community fight to discover the humanity in “the other side.”

items.title: American Hostage
items.synopsis: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

items.title: Line of Fire
items.synopsis: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

items.title: Michael Palin in the Philippines
items.synopsis: Michael Palin’s latest adventure takes him into the heart of one of the most fascinating, politically-charged and historically complicated areas on earth - the Philippines. A place still dominated by the legacy of the Marcos family and its most infamous husband and wife couple Ferdinand and Imelda, whose 21-year rule from 1965-86 ended with an alleged $10 billion theft from the nation’s coffers, as their extravagant regime was exposed.

items.title: Brothers
items.synopsis: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years—but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

items.title: Wonka's The Golden Ticket
items.synopsis: In this one-of-a-kind reality competition, lucky players step inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory to face unpredictable games, tests and temptations.

items.title: Team Moms: Baseball
items.synopsis: Follow a group of parents whose sons attend Legendary Prep Academy: a premier baseball training school in Scottsdale, Arizona, dedicated to molding the next generation of star athletes.

items.title: A Different World
